designs.character_variant_note: First approved character. Interchangeable characters are a planned feature; each future variant needs separate owner approval. Personalization is NOT available or proven.
rules: Do not regenerate, restyle, recolor, re-letter or recompose the master.
Production derivatives are separate files; a derivative that changes the look (for example removing the black background) needs an owner preview first.
Historical card drafts, shirt-ready prototypes and rejected realtor drafts are not this design.

derivatives.note: Non-generative 4x upscale to 5016 px so the art reaches print resolution; local file, delivered to owner, not stored in git.

derivatives.owner_requested: 2026-10-11 (no background color; usable on any garment color)
derivatives.note: Only the pure-black background is removed; all art pixels are untouched apart from soft edge alpha. Cream top lettering reads weakly on white/sand/gray garments; black, forest green and red read well. Residual tiny dark flecks between lettering drips possible. Owner has not yet signed off on this derivative as a commercial print file.

known_risks: Slogan echoes a famous film catchphrase; trademark/IP review not performed.
Master is 1254 px; print files are upscaled, not redrawn, so very fine detail is limited.
Transparent version: interior black art (blazer, hair, hood, mug) disappears into black garments; cream top lettering is low contrast on light garments.
